notes.title: Demon Hunter: Legacy for FREE in Google Play Store
notes.content:
[h1]Demon Hunter: Legacy[/h1]

If Alone in Space caught your interest, you might want to explore my other game, Demon Hunter: Legacy! It's a dark fantasy text adventure, and you can download it for free on Android devices without any ads:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693368/a4cf8c677260ee3a8912a4840e18d40eab113e8f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693368/03342ba8c83592f59ca302a02919f566eed8c170.png[/img][/url][b]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.istvanpogasits.demonhunter.legacy]Go to Google Play Store[/url][/b]
